create_persistent_class: create a persistent class decorator that saves source code alongside pickled PyTorch network instances
check_is_persistent: check whether a given object or class is persistent and will save source code when pickled
register_import_hook: register an import hook function that modifies pickled source code during unpickling of persistent objects
reconstruct_persistent_object: reconstruct a persistent object from pickled metadata by dynamically importing its saved source code
check_pickleable: check that a given object is pickleable by recursively validating its structure and types
